QuestInfo.name: Veggies are Awesome
QuestInfo.0: Recently, the price of veggies has skyrocketed. What happened? Last thing I need is an extra expense--mesos are tight these days!
QuestInfo.1: According to Umi, #b#o8140500##k went crazy at the farm, ruining the harvest in the process. I wonder what's going on here. It seems very strange, as if evil spirits have overcome the town. I can't let that happen! \n#t4000080#  #b#c4000080##k/200
QuestInfo.2: By eliminating #b#o8140500##k, I feel like I did my part in protecting the food table of each and everyone in Showa Town. I better start eating my veggies...

0.0: The prices on vegetables have been skyrocketing lately, and I don't like it one bit! Don't you think it's not right?

yes.0: Right? Right? You just can't live a healthy life without eating your vegetables.
yes.1: Pretty much all the vegetables that are sold here are apparently being plucked out of the farm near the Desolate Cemetery.
yes.2: There's been a sudden increase of menacing animals around here, especially the #b#o8140500#s#k that have been causing great havoc. Please eliminate them for me. I'm not sure what's going on--I once thought that there was a band of raccoons that seemed to be the ringleaders, but I haven't seem them for quite some time...ever since this strange evil aura appeared in the middle of the night. It was gone by the morning, but I wondered if that has anything to do with the strange occurrences here...
yes.3: As a sign of proof, please get me #b200 #t4000080#s#k.

no.0: Oh no no... you hate veggies?

1.0: That was fast! They were so strong that everyone had trouble with them. Thank you so much! Hope you like this as a reward!

item.0: I don't think you have collected #b#t4000080##k, yet. Keep trying.
